Robert, saw iPipeline launched its AI-first platform for life, annuities, and wealth and made the 2026 WealthTech100.

A platform launch like that usually means more in-market wealth and distribution partners worth a conversation than your team can reach before the buzz fades. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for iPipeline off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?

Robert, quick follow-up for iPipeline.

With a new platform to push into wealth management, most sales leaders can't say how many meetings they actually need to convert that momentum into pipeline, so the gap shows up late and the quarter turns into a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings iPipeline's wealth team needs this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how iPipeline's reply rate likely compares to other B2B software companies. Want to hop on a quick call and I'll walk you through it?
